title: PlayStation 5 Console
details: Sony's current-generation console, with an ultra-fast SSD that cuts loading times to seconds, ray-traced lighting and 4K output. Comes with a DualSense wireless controller.

title: DualSense Wireless Controller
details: The PS5 controller, with haptic feedback you can feel in your palms and adaptive triggers that push back when you draw a bow or brake hard. Built-in microphone and a USB-C charging port.

title: Xbox Series X
details: The most powerful Xbox, built for 4K gaming. Quick Resume lets you jump between several suspended games in seconds, and it plays thousands of titles from earlier Xbox generations.

title: Xbox Wireless Controller
details: A textured grip, a hybrid D-pad and a Share button for capturing clips. Works with Xbox consoles, Windows PCs and phones over Bluetooth.

title: Nintendo Switch
highlights: Two players out of the box
details: Play on the TV, then lift it out of the dock and keep going in handheld mode. The two Joy-Con controllers slide off the sides for instant two-player games.

title: Quest 2 VR Headset
details: A standalone VR headset: no PC, console or cables needed. Two tracked Touch controllers put your hands in the game, from Beat Saber to fitness apps.

title: Game Boy Color
details: The 1998 handheld in Dandelion yellow, tested and cleaned. Plays original Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges on two AA batteries.

title: G305 Lightspeed Wireless Mouse
highlights: Up to 250 hours per AA battery
details: A light wireless gaming mouse with Logitech's HERO sensor and a low-latency Lightspeed receiver. Runs for months on a single AA battery.

title: AirPods Max
details: Over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation, Transparency mode and spatial audio. A knit-mesh canopy and memory-foam ear cushions spread the weight for long listening.

title: WH-1000XM4 Headphones
details: Industry-leading noise cancellation, up to 30 hours of battery and Speak-to-Chat, which pauses your music when you start talking. Folds flat into the included case.

title: AirPods
details: Pop the case open and they connect to your iPhone automatically. Double-tap for Siri, and the charging case holds several extra charges.

title: Apple Watch
details: Tracks workouts, heart rate and sleep, shows notifications at a glance and lets you pay with a tap of the wrist. Bands swap in seconds.

title: iPad Pro
details: A thin, powerful tablet with a ProMotion display for smooth scrolling and drawing. Pair it with Apple Pencil for sketching and notes.

title: iPhone 15
details: Dynamic Island, a 48 MP main camera and USB-C charging, in a colour-infused glass back.

title: MacBook Air
details: A thin, fanless laptop that stays silent under load and lasts a full working day on battery. Light enough to carry everywhere.

title: Phantom 4 Drone
details: A camera drone with a stabilised gimbal for smooth aerial video, obstacle sensing and intelligent flight modes that follow a subject or orbit a point.

title: EOS DSLR Camera Kit
details: A dependable DSLR with an optical viewfinder, fast autofocus and interchangeable EF lenses. Supplied with a standard zoom kit lens.

title: Alpha Mirrorless Camera
details: A full-frame mirrorless body with eye-tracking autofocus and in-body stabilisation, compatible with Sony's range of E-mount lenses.

title: OneStep Instant Camera
details: Point, shoot and watch the print develop in your hand. A classic analogue camera with a built-in flash, made for Polaroid i-Type and 600 film.

title: Flip Portable Speaker
details: A rugged, waterproof Bluetooth speaker wrapped in tough fabric. Big sound for its size, with enough battery for a full day out.

title: Solo3 Wireless Headphones
details: On-ear headphones with a foldable design and long battery life. Quick pairing with Apple devices and on-ear controls for calls and music.

title: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum
details: A woody aromatic fragrance for men: fresh citrus up top, settling into cedar and sandalwood. Deep blue glass bottle. 100 ml.

title: Coco Noir Eau de Parfum
details: A deep, warm oriental fragrance with notes of bergamot, rose and patchouli, in a black lacquered bottle. 100 ml.

title: N°5 Eau de Parfum
details: The floral aldehyde classic, first created in 1921, in its famous square bottle. 100 ml.

title: Eros Eau de Toilette
details: Mint, green apple and vanilla in a turquoise bottle stamped with the Medusa head. Bold, sweet and long-lasting. 100 ml.

title: Acqua di Giò Eau de Toilette
details: A fresh aquatic scent inspired by the Mediterranean: sea notes, citrus and a soft woody base. An everyday classic since 1996. 100 ml.

title: The One for Men
details: A warm, spicy oriental with grapefruit, cardamom and tobacco over amber. Square glass bottle with a textured cap. 100 ml.

title: Black Opium Eau de Parfum
details: Black coffee, white flowers and vanilla in a glittering black bottle. Rich and addictive. 90 ml.

title: La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum
details: A gourmand floral built around iris, praline and vanilla, in the crystal-cut bottle shaped like a smile. 100 ml.

title: Velvet Three-Seater Sofa
details: Deep-green velvet upholstery over a solid frame, with channel-stitched back cushions and tapered wooden legs. Room for three, or one person stretched out.

title: Mid-Century Armchair
details: A winged armchair in mustard fabric on slim wooden legs. Deep enough to curl up in, compact enough for a reading corner.

title: Shell Lounge Chair
details: A low, wide lounge chair with a curved moulded shell and a smile-shaped seat, on three splayed legs.

title: Adjustable Floor Lamp
details: A matte steel floor lamp with a shade that tilts to point light exactly where you need it. A reading light beside a sofa or a soft uplight in a corner.

title: Six-Cup Pour-Over Coffeemaker
details: The hourglass-shaped glass brewer with a wooden collar, designed in 1941. Its thick bonded filters make a clean, bright cup.

title: Enamelled Cast Iron Casserole
details: Holds heat evenly for slow braises, stews and bread. Goes from hob to oven to table.

title: Burr Coffee Grinder
details: Conical steel burrs give an even grind from espresso-fine to French-press coarse. Dial in your setting once and get the same result every morning.

title: Stoneware Cup Set
details: Four handleless cups in speckled stoneware, each slightly different. Sized for espresso, tea or a small glass of wine.

title: Chef's Knife Set
details: Four forged steel knives, a carving fork and a honing steel, with wooden handles and a canvas roll to keep them together.

title: Air Jordan 1 Mid
details: The basketball shoe that started it all in 1985, in a mid-top cut. Leather upper, Air cushioning and the Wings logo on the collar.

title: Air Force 1 '07
details: The all-white leather classic, first released in 1982. Crisp overlays, a padded low-cut collar and Air cushioning underfoot.

title: SB Dunk High
details: A high-top skate shoe with a padded tongue, a grippy gum-rubber outsole and Zoom Air cushioning in the heel.

title: 247 Sneaker
details: A lightweight lifestyle trainer with a sock-like fit, a breathable upper and the big N on the side.

title: Air Max
details: The visible Air unit in the heel, a breathable mesh upper and a sculpted midsole. Comfortable for easy runs and long days on your feet.

title: Flyknit Running Shoe
details: A lightweight Flyknit upper that moves with your foot, on a flexible foam sole. Built for daily runs.

title: NBA Outdoor Basketball
details: A size 7 rubber basketball with deep channels for grip, made to hold up on tarmac and concrete courts.

title: Champions League Match Ball
details: The star-panel design of the UEFA Champions League ball. A size 5 thermally bonded ball for grass and artificial pitches.
